_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Queued and transcribing conversation messages share the source header. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} was started with "echo: queue provenance". The test adds three queued messages, all created one second after the page's fake clock starts, to what the server says of it, and cuts its stream off: "Queued progress" from the subagent "backend", and two voice transcriptions (one working, one failed) from the parent conversation "{{SLUG}}". The page runs on a fake clock that steps drive with window.__clock; it is paused at the messages' creation time when the page loads. "The ghost" is the element with data-testid "queued-ghost", "the tasks" the elements with data-testid "transcription-task". 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. There must be exactly 2 tasks (allow 30s). 3. There must be exactly 0 ghosts. 4. Eval window.__clock.runFor(1999) on its own (it returns a promise the step awaits). 5. There must still be exactly 0 ghosts. 6. Eval window.__clock.runFor(1) on its own. 7. The ghost's element with data-testid "message-author-conversation" should read exactly "Message from backend". 8. Eval document.querySelector('[data-testid="queued-ghost"]').classList.contains('message-tool'): it must return true. 9. Eval getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-testid="queued-ghost"]')).backgroundColor: it must return exactly "rgb(243, 244, 246)". 10. The ghost's [data-testid="queued-badge"] should be visible. 11. The ghost should contain "Queued progress". 12. For each task, i = 0 and i = 1 of document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="transcription-task"]'): eval getComputedStyle(<task i>).backgroundColor, which must return exactly "rgb(243, 244, 246)", and eval <task i>.querySelector('[data-testid="message-author-conversation"]').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), which must return exactly "Message from {{SLUG}}".
